summary: Bolt is an open-source content management system written in PHP that focuses on straightforward publishing workflows. It provides a structured interface for organising and delivering web content without the complexity of larger enterprise platforms. The project is distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits developers and small teams looking for a lightweight PHP-based publishing tool that is easy to modify and deploy.
watchOut: With a relatively small community and modest repository activity, you may find fewer third-party plugins and community-maintained extensions compared to dominant alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard PHP runtime environment, a web server such as Nginx or Apache, and a compatible relational database to store your content.
